QuestInfo.name: [Sia Astelle] A Voyager Revealed
QuestInfo.2: You met Voyager in #m867172019#...only for your oldest friend to reveal his true identity and purpose: He was Marvin, the star hunter. He attacked, claiming that you would bring disaster as the thirteenth constellation. But upon being struck, you awoke in the Spirit King's Forest.\r\nThere, you encountered #p9402184# and heard that you had awakened to your true nature as the Guide of the Stars. Yet, the prophecy of the thirteenth constellation still promises ruin...
